intended_behavior: Add a private instance variable _tool_choice initialized to {"auto": {}} to support configurable tool choice.
Use the instance variable self._tool_choice for the "toolChoice" key instead of the hardcoded {"auto": {}} to allow dynamic tool choice configuration.

Temporarily override self._tool_choice with {"tool": {"name": tool_spec["name"]}} during the call to self.stream to specify the structured output tool. After the call, restore the original _tool_choice value. This enables more precise model responses as requested, preserving the existing streaming and output parsing logic.
